reserveReview.rationale: Exodus identifies XO as issued and managed by MoonPay using M0 infrastructure, while M0's extension and Solana documentation define the wrap/unwrap model over $M and the m_vault PDA that holds the backing $M. Verified directly on chain at Solana slot 443400427 (2026-09-01T10:26:09Z): the XO m_vault token account GeBTfYujk4JLr2MBCZznMTLTGch1QrUyYcMKen4KUFU2 (authority CRp6Mt7viCYmNhL1eVbQvH4SPmsrJoZvUAcrvwhqeWPe) held 2,384,487.692445 principal units of $M mzerojk9tg56ebsrEAhfkyc9VgKjTW2zDqp6C5mhjzH, or 2,606,906.391188 $M at the current M0 index (scaled-UI multiplier 1.093277352384), against an XO supply of 2,572,588.650176 on mint xoUSDq85Rjsb6SbUwJyreFgeWQvxdkT7R3c3g7s6p5Y - 101.33% coverage by $M alone. The 2026-08-11 M0 Portal ReceiveMessage transaction independently shows XO being minted while that exact vault is credited with $M, confirming it is XO's backing account. The complete direct claim is therefore the tracked m-m0 parent, whose own collateral composition stays reviewed on that entry rather than being duplicated here. XO-specific legal custody terms and provider shares remain undisclosed.
